sourceTitle: A Monograph of the Trilobites of North America: with Coloured Models of the Species
description: "A Monograph of the Trilobites of North America: with Coloured Models of the Species" by Jacob Green is a scientific publication written in the early 19th century. This detailed work focuses on the classification and description of trilobite fossils found in North America, combining text with colored models to illustrate various species.
